messages: Does #p425# at #m10003007# know anything about the evil spirit somewhere in #m10003000#?�

#p425# at #m10003007# couldn't hide the seriousness on her face when I mentioned that #p900014# had been sensing a powerful evil spirit somewhere in #m10003000#. After thinking it over for a while, she said the only one she could think of was the girl at #b#m10003004##k, and asked me to go check on #b#p412##k. Something about this doesn't sit right with me... \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.#k
After some hesitation, I went and met #p412# at #b#m10003004##k. But the girl I hadn't seen in a while... no, the girl's ghost, seemed to know something.
name: A Name She Couldn't Say
